scripts.dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && pnpm run start
scripts.player-projections:baseline:dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm exec esbuild src/player-projections-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:*.node --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/player-projections-cli.cjs && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/player-projections-cli.cjs
scripts.player-projections:independent:dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm exec esbuild src/player-projections-independent-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:*.node --external:pg-native --outfile=dist/player-projections-independent-cli.cjs && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/player-projections-independent-cli.cjs
scripts.player-projections:readiness:dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/player-forecast-readiness-dev-cli.mjs
scripts.capture:espn-rosters:dev: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/espn-roster-dev-cli.mjs
scripts.sportsdataio-depth-evaluation: export NODE_ENV=development && pnpm run build && node --enable-source-maps ./dist/sportsdataio-depth-cli.mjs
scripts.test:production-schema-order:dev: pnpm run build && NODE_ENV=development GRIDLINE_DISPOSABLE_SCHEMA_TEST=1 node --test ./dist/lib/production-schema-order.dev.test.mjs
scripts.pretypecheck: if [ "${WORKSPACE_LIBS_PREBUILT:-0}" != "1" ]; then pnpm --dir ../.. run typecheck:libs; fi
